notes:
Nocto 0.9.0
- Multi-track audio recording with per-source track routing (Windows and Linux)
- Scene transitions, Studio Mode and a live stream-health indicator
- Blur and Pixelate source filters, plus a Pixelate effect in the editor
- Clips and chapter markers; automatic loudness normalization
- Export presets and vertical (9:16) canvas
- Twitch chat overlay, color eyedropper, frame export, Discord plugin
- Compact Controls panel and status bar; new UI scale setting
- Fixed hardware encoder detection
- Linux ARM: V4L2 hardware encoders (with software fallback)
- New: Linux ARM64 (aarch64) AppImage

linux-x64.label: Linux
linux-x64.requirements: Linux x86_64 (Wayland or X11, PipeWire, Mesa 24+ or NVIDIA driver)
linux-x64.install:
Install: download the AppImage, then run chmod +x Nocto-0.9.0-x86_64.AppImage and start it with ./Nocto-0.9.0-x86_64.AppImage.

Needs: a Wayland or X11 desktop with PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal, and your distribution's GPU drivers (Mesa 24+ for Intel/AMD, or the NVIDIA proprietary driver). Recommended: GStreamer plugins-base and plugins-good for browser source audio; the v4l2loopback camera driver for the virtual camera in Discord/Zoom (Nocto offers a one-click setup with your desktop's password dialog, no terminal needed). Updates install from inside Nocto (checksum verified, with automatic rollback); if you are on 0.7.2 or older, download this one manually once.
